'''Salaking''' is a place in [[Seanchan]].

[[Semirhage]] told to [[Suroth]] that [[Seandar]] was in chaos and there was war from the [[Aldael Mountains]] to Salaking{{ref/book|11|p}}, so Salaking is probably in one of far ends of the Empire; no more is known about it.
